content.text: All preferred elements appear satisfied; no redline needed.

input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: Section 21 meets our preferred position in full. 21.1 sets a mutual aggregate cap at the greater of Fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000, and "Fees" (1.5) is a meaningful base covering recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees rather than a nominal set-up charge. 21.2 excludes indirect, incidental, special, exemplary, punitive and consequential damages mutually ("neither Party"), and helpfully confirms data-restoration, replacement-service, notice and incident-response costs are direct damages. 21.3 places outside the cap, as Excluded Claims, each Party's breach of confidentiality, data-protection or security obligations, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's IP; those carve-outs are genuinely uncapped (excepted from both 21.1 and 21.2), not merely multiplied. 21.3 also confirms Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees is not damages and is not limited by the Section. No competing cap, super-cap or one-sided limitation appears elsewhere (no separate indemnity cap; 21.4 is standard savings language). No redline proposed.
